classification.difficultyReason: Read each supplied graph's y-intercept, horizontal asymptote and direction at each end using the explicitly taught feature-identification method.

spec.description: Integer square grid from −5 to 5, labelled axes and arrowheads; origin unnumbered. Blue curve with arrowheads at both ends.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied graph remains visible in the student edition.

answer.worked: The curve approaches the $x$-axis, so its horizontal asymptote is $y=0$.
The right-hand branch decreases without bound, so $y\to-\infty$.
The left-hand branch approaches $y=0$ from below, so $y\to0$.

spec.description: Integer square grid from −5 to 5, labelled axes and arrowheads; origin unnumbered. Blue curve with arrowheads at both ends.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied graph remains visible in the student edition.

answer.worked: The left-hand branch approaches the horizontal line $y=3$.
The right-hand branch increases without bound, so $y\to\infty$.
The left-hand branch approaches $y=3$ from above, so $y\to3$.
